# Mamdani Appoints De Blasio Alum Liz Vladeck to Lead Labor Relations Office

A veteran of city government and the current general counsel at the Department of Education, Vladeck will lead negotiations with municipal unions whose contracts will soon expire.

Avatar photo  by Claudia Irizarry Aponte

results.content:
The ap­point­ments came amid changes to the group’s lead­er­ship suc­ces­sion plans. On Thurs­day, RFHL re­versed its pub­licly an­nounced de­ci­sion to ap­point Richard Sam­my as its next group pres­i­dent and chief ex­ec­u­tive of­fi­cer, re­plac­ing him with Karen Yip Chuck less than nine months af­ter nam­ing him to suc­ceed Nigel Bap­tiste. [...] Robin­son al­so served as act­ing man­ag­ing di­rec­tor of Re­pub­lic Bank (Suri­name) N.V. and act­ing man­ag­ing di­rec­tor of Re­pub­lic Bank (Guyana).

The ap­point­ments were an­nounced in a news re­lease sent yes­ter­day by RFHL. [...] 20261017

Re­pub­lic Fi­nan­cial Hold­ings Lim­it­ed (RFHL) yes­ter­day an­nounced two ex­ec­u­tive ap­point­ments, with Paras­ram (Vic) Sal­ick­ram and David Robin­son set to take up se­nior po­si­tions at the fi­nan­cial hold­ings com­pa­ny and its T&T sub­sidiary Re­pub­lic Bank Ltd from Jan­u­ary 1, 2027, sub­ject to reg­u­la­to­ry ap­provals.

results.title: Pope Leo XIV appoints members of International Theological Commission - Vatican News
results.content:
The Commission brings together theologians from different schools and nations, distinguished by their scholarship and fidelity to the Church’s Magisterium.

Its members, numbering no more than 30, are appointed by the Pope for five-year terms, following a proposal by the Dicastery’s Prefect and consultation with Bishops’ Conferences.

The results of its studies are submitted to the Pope and made available to the Dicastery for its work. [...] Vatican News

The International Theological Commission begins its 2026-2031 term, comprising 30 members, up from 28 in the previous term, with increased representation from Asia, Africa, and South America.

On Monday, Pope Leo XIV appointed 24 new members, confirming 6 others, including Msgr. Piero Coda for another five years as the Commission’s Secretary General. [...] I AGREE
